recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14158; future DeviceUsage changes should be checked in the HL7 OO incubator source. Do not publish another FHIR-35979 commit because the combined branch already contains its audit.
issue_request: FHIR-14158 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification OO change request for STU3 DeviceUseStatement asking to use reasonReference for implant/explant procedure context, update the example, and correct the element spelling from bodysite to bodySite.
initial_application: Commit 1639b8d104fc8901a5f6576bcb044981c1320bc4 preapplied GF#14158 by changing the DeviceUseStatement example to Procedure/example and renaming DeviceUseStatement.bodysite to DeviceUseStatement.bodySite. That application did not add Procedure to the allowed reasonReference target list, leaving a mismatch that was later handled by FHIR-35979.
additional_context: FHIR-35979 was a later Published/Persuasive OO issue in the same change family and approved adding Procedure support to DeviceUseStatement.reasonReference/DeviceUsage.reason; PR history added Procedure to DeviceUsage.reason. Current source/fhir.ini has no active DeviceUsage resource entry, and core module pages link DeviceUsage to the HL7 OO incubator IG. The retained core source and current OO incubator StructureDefinition both include Procedure as a DeviceUsage.reason target and model body location with DeviceUsage.bodyStructure rather than the old bodysite/bodySite element.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch because the current core checkout does not build the DeviceUseStatement/DeviceUsage resource, and the active external artifact already reflects the intended Procedure reason support.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue fixed the Procedure target mismatch left visible after the FHIR-14158 example change; it is already represented on the combined branch.
